programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Hum-nata; Pups Stop the Foggy Skies
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger's birthday party goes horribly awry when Marshall Kitty gets trapped inside a life-sized piñata; Mayor Humdinger tries pushing fog into Adventure Bay, it's up to the PAW Patrol to find animals missing in the clouds and save the day.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Whale Pod; Ultimate Rescue: Pups Stop the Junk-Monster
programs.desc: When Francois accidentally crashes his diving bell, the PAW Patrol must rescue him; when Wingnut's junk pile and Oscar go missing at the same time, Chase and team are called in to solve the mystery.

programs.title: Mr. Crocodile
programs.sub_title: Granny Zanny; Croc Gets a Job
programs.desc: Toothy, lovable Mr. Crocodile, with his best friend Daisy by his side, navigates the human world in a series of zany adventures.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Runaway Rooster; Pups Save a Snowbound Cow
programs.desc: Chickaletta and Roosterio run away from a chicken show and get stuck on top of a runaway drone. When Bettina wanders up Jake's mountain and gets caught in a snowstorm, it's up to the PAW Patrol to bring her safely down.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Hum-Patrol to the Rescue!; Pups Save Morning Mountain Yoga
programs.desc: When Adventure Bay holds a raffle, a pair of nest-building seagulls snatch the winning prize; a rockslide leaves Mayor Goodway, Farmer Yumi and Garby stranded on the side of a mountain.

programs.title: Rubble & Crew
programs.sub_title: The Crew Builds a Vet Clinic; The Crew Builds a Mermaid Party
programs.desc: When the traveling veterinarian Dr. Diwa can't finish all her checkups in Builder Cove in time, Rubble and crew know just what to do; Lily's mermaid-themed birthday party is called off when it starts to rain.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Big BBQ
programs.desc: Adventure Bay gets a fire station; when disaster strikes during the opening day BBQ, it's up to the PAW Patrol in their new fire rescue gear and vehicles to put it out.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.desc: Skye, Liberty and Everest take off on a road trip to Yellowstone National Park and need to use their mini-rescue rides to save a bunch of baby animals.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Mighty Pups Stop the Mighty Queen; Mighty Pups Stop the Hiccups
programs.desc: The Mighty Pups must stop Sweetie from using her new powers to take over Adventure Bay; Mighty Nano gets the hiccups, so it's up to Liberty and the Mighty Pups to find a cure.

programs.title: The Smurfs
programs.sub_title: Lucretia Seizes Power; Papa Smurf Lost His Mind
programs.desc: Gargamel brings Lucretia to life to guard his captured Smurfs; Papa Smurf creates a potion that will give him back his youth, but a spider makes its way into the recipe!

programs.title: Sonic Prime
programs.desc: Sonic races to No Place to save the pirates before their world collapses, but Nine still needs Sonic's energy to power the Paradox Prism.

programs.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programs.desc: SpongeBob obtains a magician's wand and accidentally causes magical mayhem wherever he goes; on Friday the 13th, Mr. Krabs' extreme superstitions become a disruption for everyone around him.
